title: feat(spawn): add autocompact thresholds for sessions and workers
context:
Add Sessions & Spawning settings for Claude Code auto-compact window,
separate for new sessions (auto_compact_k) and WatchTower workers
(worker_auto_compact_k), defaulting to 250K.

Server persists the two new keys in spawn-defaults.json, validates the
50-1000K range, and injects CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW into the
spawned process environment. The new-session default is explicitly
passed through the spawn path so it survives worker routing, while the
worker default is used by worker-spawned
decision: Introduced server.py, static/app.js, tests/test_smoke.py: added _validate_auto_compact_k, _spawn_auto_compact_k_tokens, _spawn_env, _mergeAutoCompactK; changed spawn_session_remote.
